target: Calegari Question 7.5: replace each real fundamental cycle by a same-norm cycle normal to some nonempty essential lamination, in the intended unrestricted class.
accepted_conclusions: Lemmas 2.1–2.4 and Theorem 2.5: topological normal reparameterization, explicit cone null-homology, fresh support and exact padding.
Theorems 3.1–3.2 and Corollaries 3.3–3.4: fixed and flexible upper-ray spectra, exact infimum-plus-endpoint criterion, nonattainment reduction and uniform-gap obstruction.
Propositions 4.1–4.2 and Consequence 4.3: ordinary finite-chain nonattainment for zero-volume and closed hyperbolic manifolds, with the carrying-one hypothesis in applications.
Qualified applications of prior normalization and surface theorems; Li tightening remains a restricted attributed unaudited premise.
Authored local descent obstruction and abstract endpoint example, neither a manifold counterexample.
remaining_gap: Prove flexible normal infimum equality N(M)=V(M) and endpoint preservation whenever the ordinary infimum is attained, for the intended unrestricted essential-lamination setting; alternatively supply a genuine target-admissible counterexample. In the nonattained case a counterexample requires a uniform positive gap across all essential laminations, allowing an empty normal-cycle spectrum.
mathematical_dependencies: The cited prior normalization, Gabai–Oertel consequences, hyperbolic straightening/proportionality and fixed-foliation norm-gap results retain their stated hypotheses. Li's inaccessible preliminary proof is not independently audited or promoted to established general tightening.
